data.name: Greek War
data.detailed_description:
Choose your civilization. Build your army. Dominate the tactical field.

Greek War is a 3D turn-based tactical strategy game that fuses the wits of chess with the cunning of tic-tac-toe, all set on a battlefield inspired by the grandeur of Ancient Greece. Prepare your deck, choose your civilization, and face players from around the world in mental duels where every move can seal glory… or defeat.

                    Você está pronto para provar seu valor entre os heróis das lendas?

About this game

          War echoes through the sacred fields of Greece. Sparta, Athens, Thebes, and Delos vie for supremacy in a world where myths and tactics intertwine. Each civilization carries its own ideals, strategies, and heroes, and it's up to you to dominate them on the war board.

          In Greek War, every turn is a critical decision, every unit a key piece. Deploy troops, form victory lines, and surprise your opponent with tactical cards that can turn the tide. Here, strategy and foresight are not only welcome, they're indispensable.

 

Main features:

Chess meets Tic Tac Toe

         Master a hybrid combat system on a 6x4 board where the objective is to form lines with your units, like a game of tic tac toe, but with the strategic complexity of chess.

Civilizations with unique styles
           Play with factions inspired by Ancient Greece:

  • Sparta, with its brute force and direct offense,

  • Athens, which prioritizes flexibility and tactical manipulation.

  • Thebes and Delos, each with distinct mechanics and unique cards to master different approaches to battle.

Strategic deckbuilding
          Build your deck with up to 25 cards, including units and support cards, and adapt your strategy before each match. Hand management and order of use make all the difference.

Real-time (turn-based) tactical battles
          Challenge players in online multiplayer duels. The matchmaking system ensures balanced confrontations, while the ranked mode encourages the birth of legends on the battlefield.

Epic Immersion
          Travel through settings inspired by the art and architecture of Ancient Greece. An epic soundtrack and detailed environments transform each match into a chapter in a legendary war.

Competition and mastery
          More than winning, what matters here is overcoming. Learn from each defeat, refine your strategy, and climb the rankings like a true Greek commander.

 

                                                    War shapes heroes.

                            Choose your side. Form your line. Win with honor.
